overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Heming 2-Person Corner Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a luxurious and health-focused retreat right in your home. Designed for optimal relaxation and wellness, this sauna features 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels that provide even, soothing heat to help relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and enhance circulation. Constructed from elegant Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, it fits perfectly in indoor spaces like basements or master baths. With Bluetooth connectivity and an interior chromotherapy lighting system, this sauna transforms your space into a personalized spa experience.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas are constructed of environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood planks. Our saunas feature energy efficient Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that help relax and rejuvenate the body. Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can also be added to a fitness room.
